message: Enable --use_fast_math build flag: scalar kernel is dominated by per-column expf/division; fast-math SFU approximations raise geomean TFLOPS from 2.38 to 2.96 while staying well within error tolerance.

Scalar kernel vectorization: BLOCK_M 32→64 with 8 warps, 8/16-byte vectorized global loads/stores and shared-memory reads, plus GQA support in the launcher (per-block KV base offset). Fixes the previous attempt's epilogue bug (__bfloat16_as_ushort).

Scalar kernel inner-loop restructure: iterate K/V columns outer, query rows inner, so each K/V column is read from shared once and consumed by all 8 query rows (cuts shared traffic ~8x) with per-row causal masking at the softmax update.

Restructure scalar kernel inner loop: iterate K/V columns outer, all ROWS_PER_WARP query rows inner — each shared column read once per 8 rows (cuts shared traffic ~8x), halves FP32 dot-product work by sharing the column across Q and V updates. 4.73 quick TFLOPS (was 3.82).

Fuse online-softmax correction and output accumulation into one loop; hoist shared K/V column bf16->fp32 conversion once per column (shared across all 8 rows per warp). Removes m_new/corr/p arrays and redundant rescale FMAs. 6.61 quick TFLOPS (was 4.73).

FA2-style deferred-rescaling online softmax: keep acc/sum in the domain of the running max; on a new row max rescale history once (rare for random scores), steady state = 1 __expf + 1 add + 4 FFMA per (row,col) instead of 2 expf + corr rescale FMAs. 6.78 quick TFLOPS (was 6.62).

Compile-time causal specialization: template<bool CAUSAL> kernel with runtime branch dispatch — removes per-column causal checks from the hot loop (the loop-carried `if (causal && ...)` branches become compile-time). 6.92 quick TFLOPS (was 6.78).
